description: Tell QualiLoop the agent changed, after you change its prompt, tools, flows or documentation. QualiLoop works out which parts of the agent the change touches, treats what it knew about them as possibly out of date, and, unless explore is false, explores them again so the next tests aim at what changed. Call it once per change you deploy, with a precise description. Reports within an hour of the last one join that change. Tell the user what the exploration costs; when the answer says none was started, tell them why (exploration_note).

description.description: What changed in the agent, in a sentence or two: a prompt, a tool, a flow, the documentation it answers from. The more precise, the narrower the re-check.
description.title: Description

explore.description: Explore the changed part of the agent again: up to 24 conversation credits (none for the project's first exploration), at most 2 explorations started by changes per project a day. False only records it.
explore.title: Explore

project.description: The project's number (as the app shows it, e.g. 12 or '#12') or its name. Optional when the organization has one project.
project.title: Project

name: report_change
